_comment: Rename the right-hand values to match your export's column names. Anything you cannot export, leave out — the migrator tolerates missing columns and tells you what it could not fill.
_images: Run with --manifest first to list every image the export references, convert those, then point imageBlocks at the result. imageBaseUrl is only needed if the export stores filenames rather than full URLs; it also takes a single string when both kinds share a folder. questionImageId/optionImageId default to {image} and only need setting if your images:convert manifest is keyed some other way ({id} is the question or option id).
